Name: Buy All Vanilla Animals
Author: mushymato
Description:
[size=3][b]Overview[/b][/size]
Allows you to buy the 4 normally not purchasable animals, after meeting a certain unlock condition.

[list]
[*][b]Void Chicken[/b]: Unlock the Sewer, buy from new vendor next to Krobus for 50 Void Essence.
[*][b]Golden Chicken[/b]: Unlock the Sewer, buy from new vendor next to Krobus for 100 Solar Essence, requires completing Community Center/Joja, and Deluxe Coop
[*][b]Dinosaur[/b]: Reach floor 120 of the Mines, buy from Marnie, requires Big Coop.
[*][b]Ostrich[/b]: Reach the Caldera, buy from the Island Field Office for 30 Cinder Shard, requires Deluxe Barn.
[/list]
Blue Chicken is not included, because you can buy her normally once you seen Shane's event.

[b][size=3]Installation
[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the dependencies: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]﻿
[*]Download and extract this mod to your Mods folder
[/list]
[b][size=3]Configuration
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Each of the 4 animals can be individually disabled (default on for all 4)
[*]Available From Marnie: Makes Void Chicken/Golden Chicken/Ostrich available via from Marnie's Ranch for money.
[/list]
